field_interpretation_notes.air_yards: Numeric pass outcome/trajectory field; not a route tree or named concept.
field_interpretation_notes.nfl_hist_depth_charts.formation: Roster/depth-chart field, not per-play offensive formation.
field_interpretation_notes.nulls: Keep null values distinct from rows with no matched source record.
field_interpretation_notes.offense_personnel: Preserve exact raw strings; observed value encoding differs by season.

scope.join_key_rule: Exact source key join on game ID and native play ID; no fuzzy match.
scope.play_signature_warning: A repeated observed-field signature is not evidence of an identical play design or concept.

action_descriptor.confidence: high for recorded values; coarse execution descriptors, not an exact design

broad_charting_tags.confidence: high for present literal tags; broad charting categories, not exact play designs

context_excluded_from_signature_equality.confidence: recorded context/outcome fields; retained as attributes, not stable design identity

event.confidence: high for recorded event label; not design identity

presentation.confidence: high for present literal labels; joined coverage is source- and season-specific

record_identity.confidence: high for a unique source execution record

signature_schema.same_tuple_interpretation: Same tuple means same observed values and source-join state only.
